title: Lost Mary Nera15K Triple Mango Prefilled Vape Pods
description: Designed for use with the Lost Mary Nera30K Fullview Prefilled Pod Kit, the Lost Mary Nera15K Prefilled Pods offer a seamless, flavour-packed vaping experience with up to 15,000 puffs per refill pack. Each replacement pod pack includes a 2ml built-in mesh coil pod prefilled with Lost Mary’s signature nic salt e-liquid (20mg), plus an innovative 10ml auto-refilling e-liquid container that keeps your pod topped up for longer-lasting satisfaction. Triple Mango delivers a bold and indulgent fusion of three distinct Mango varieties, balancing sun-ripened sweetness with a rich, tropical vibrancy. The result is a smooth and full-bodied vape bursting with layers of ripe, exotic fruit flavour. With an easy push-to-refill system, a visible e-liquid window for effortless monitoring, and premium mesh coil technology, the Lost Mary Nera15K Prefilled Pods ensure consistently smooth and satisfying mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping. How to Use: 1. Remove all packaging and protective film. 2. Separate the 2ml prefilled pod and 10ml refill container. 3. Push the refill container into the pod until it clicks securely. 4. Attach the pod to your Nera30K device and remove the silicone plug from the mouthpiece. 5. Vape and enjoy. Once the e-liquid runs out, simply swap in a new Nera15K pod pack from a selection of 20 incredible Lost Mary flavour profiles.
